iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

decode_uri
       Decodes the specified string using HTTP URI encoding.

SYNOPSIS
       decode_uri ANY_CHARS

DESCRIPTION
       Decodes the specified string using HTTP URI encoding per RFC2616 and returns the result. This is a BIG-IP 4.x variable,
       provided for backward-compatibiliy. You can use the equivalent 9.X commmand URI::decode instead.

       Syntax

       decode_uri 

	    * Decodes the specified string using HTTP URI encoding per RFC2616
	      and returns the result.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
